name: Shiitake Mushroom

low.description: About 5 medium mushrooms or 2/3 cup sliced

siboNotes: Shiitake mushrooms are well-tolerated in SIBO as they're low FODMAP and don't contain significant fermentable carbohydrates. Their umami flavor can enhance dishes without triggering symptoms.
preparationTips: Remove tough stems before cooking - they can be fibrous and harder to digest
Sauté or roast to concentrate flavors and improve digestibility
Start with smaller portions if you're sensitive to dietary fiber
Fresh shiitakes have better texture than rehydrated dried ones for sensitive stomachs
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially B5 and B6
Good source of selenium and copper
